title: Your story, *sharpened*.
subtitle: Editors who keep your voice and help every page earn its place.
caption:
Every great book is rewritten, and you don't have to do it alone.

Our editors work with you on the big picture (structure, pacing, character) and the fine detail (flow, clarity, consistency), and they keep the voice that makes your book yours.

Tell us about your manuscript and we'll suggest the right edit.
short: Your story, sharpened. Editors who keep your voice and help every page earn its place. Tell us about your manuscript.

title: Readers *do* judge a book by its cover.
subtitle: Covers made for your genre that read clearly on a shelf and on a phone screen.
caption:
Readers do judge a book by its cover, usually in a couple of seconds.

Our designers make covers that fit your genre, stay readable as a tiny thumbnail, and look great on the shelf, from the ebook front to the full print wrap with spine and back cover.

Ready to give your book the cover it deserves?
short: Readers do judge a book by its cover. We design ebook covers and full print wraps made for your genre.

title: 3 signs your manuscript is *ready* for an editor
points: Your full draft is finished, ending included.
You've revised it yourself at least once.
You can sum up your book in two sentences.
caption:
Wondering if it's time for an editor? Here are three signs you're ready:

1. Your full draft is finished, ending included.
2. You've revised it yourself at least once.
3. You can sum up your book in two sentences.

Ticked all three? Let's talk. Not there yet? Keep going. Every finished draft started as a messy one.

Save this for later.
short: 3 signs your manuscript is ready for an editor: 1) the full draft is finished, 2) you've revised it once yourself, 3) you can sum it up in two sentences.

title: Hold *your* book in your hands.
subtitle: Paperback and hardcover, printed on real paper you'll be proud to sign.
caption:
There's nothing like holding your own book for the first time.

We print paperbacks and hardcovers on quality paper, so your book looks and feels the way you imagined it, whether it's one copy for your shelf or a box for your launch event.

Ask us about print options for your book.
short: There's nothing like holding your own book for the first time. Paperback and hardcover printing for your book.

quote: There is no greater agony than bearing an *untold story* inside you.
author: Maya Angelou
source: I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings
caption:
"There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you." (Maya Angelou)

What's the story you've been carrying? Tell us in the comments.
short: "There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you." (Maya Angelou) What's the story you've been carrying?

title: Read it. Swipe it. *Hear* it.
subtitle: Reach readers on every screen, and listeners on every commute.
points: Print and digital from one manuscript
caption:
Some readers want paper. Some read on a phone at midnight. Some listen on the drive to work.

We turn your manuscript into a properly formatted ebook and a produced audiobook, so your book can meet readers wherever they are.

Which format are you most excited about?
short: Some readers want paper, some read on a phone, some listen on the way to work. Ebook and audiobook editions for your book.

subtitle: 5 steps, and where we help

slides.title: Write
slides.body: Finish your draft. It doesn't have to be perfect, just complete.

slides.title: Edit

slides.title: Design
slides.body: A cover made for your genre, and an interior that's a pleasure to read.

caption:
From first page to final print in 5 steps (swipe →)

1. Write: finish the draft
2. Edit: shape structure and style
3. Design: cover and interior
4. Print: paperback, hardcover, ebook, audiobook
5. Share: retailers, libraries and your own bookshop

Which step are you on? We help with every step after the first.
short: From first page to final print in 5 steps: Write, Edit, Design, Print, Share. Which step are you on?

title: Every book starts as a *dream*.
body: Editing, design, printing and distribution for independent authors.
caption:
Every book starts as a dream. Ours is helping you finish yours.

DREM Book helps independent authors turn manuscripts into beautiful books, with editing, design, printing and worldwide distribution.

Send us a message and tell us about your book.
short: Every book starts as a dream. DREM Book helps independent authors turn manuscripts into beautiful books. Tell us about yours.
